definitions.explanation: An item on a program or a performance presented at a festival, school event, cultural gathering, or entertainment venue.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{出|だ}し{物|もの}は{何|なん}ですか。
{文化祭|ぶんかさい}の{出|だ}し{物|もの}を{決|き}めよう。
examples.english: Let's decide on our attraction for the school festival.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{忘年会|ぼうねんかい}では、{各部署|かくぶしょ}が{出|だ}し{物|もの}を{用意|ようい}することになった。
examples.english: Each department was asked to prepare a performance for this year's year-end party.

notes:
Derived from {出|だ}す (to put out, to present) + {物|もの} (thing). Refers to anything presented as entertainment or as part of a program.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}を{用意|ようい}する: to prepare a show/attraction
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}を{決|き}める: to decide on a performance
- {出|だ}し{物|もの}の{練習|れんしゅう}: rehearsal for a show
- {余興|よきょう}の{出|だ}し{物|もの}: an entertainment act

USAGE:
This word is commonly used in the context of school festivals ({文化祭|ぶんかさい}, {学園祭|がくえんさい}), company parties ({忘年会|ぼうねんかい}, {新年会|しんねんかい}), and community events ({祭|まつ}り). Each group or class typically prepares a {出|だ}し{物|もの} — which can range from skits and dances to food stalls and haunted houses.
